svg.title: The parser on write i - j
svg.text: the tokens; the marked one is next

g.title: parse makes the program node. The next token, write, is not the end of the file, so it calls stmt.
stmt makes its node and looks at one token: write chooses the write statement. stmt takes it, and write is a leaf.
stmt calls expr for the expression after write. expr's node is made, not yet hung under stmt's.
expr calls term for its first operand.
term calls factor, which sees a name, i, and takes it.
factor returns, and term hangs its node under its own. The next token, -, is not * or /: term is done.
term returns, and expr hangs it. The next token is -, one of + and -, so expr goes on.
expr takes - as a leaf of its own.
expr calls term for the operand after the -.
term calls factor, which takes the name j.
factor returns, and term hangs it. Next is the end of the file, not * or /.
term returns, and expr hangs it. The end of the file is not + or -: expr is done.
expr returns, and stmt hangs it: the write statement is whole.
stmt returns, and parse hangs it under program.
parse sees the end of the file and stops. The leaves, left to right, are the tokens.
